free_tier.stated: anonymous guest read of 15 root entries; no account and no payment

per_object_cap.stated: the upstream provider's cap; the instance publishes none

retention.stated: until the operator's account or tenant fails; no TTL and no notice

egress.terms: served through cloudflare; the reader pays nothing

tooling: the AList/OpenList REST surface (/api/fs/list, /api/fs/get, /api/fs/put) and the WebDAV endpoint at /dav; the rclone alist backend speaks the REST
chaining: a fetch substrate: point a cache and two mirrors at it, never a write tier

limits.value: PUT denied at the guest role

identity_cost.detail: no registration; /api/me returns a guest session

reliability_note: 15 root entries on OpenList v4.2.7, Cloudflare-fronted, write:true advertised and denied.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, JSON carrying a code field, site_title '电喵科技'
anonymous POST /api/fs/list on / returned code 200 with 15 root entries; write:true, write_content_bypass:False, provider:unknown
the zero-byte oracle (PUT at an existing directory with Overwrite:false) returned code 403 with message 'permission denied' inside HTTP 200, so the write permission failed and nothing was written
